summary: Built a self-contained VS Code Remote workspace extension (tools/vscode-geoai-task-operations) that surfaces the existing Task MCP dashboard as an Activity Bar launcher/status view plus one retained full-editor WebviewPanel, sourcing data exclusively from the dashboard's own /api/* endpoints. Health check runs on the remote/workspace extension host against the raw configured loopback URL; on failure with autoStart=true it starts exactly one repo-local `python3 -m aiworkhub.dashboard` process (never a duplicate, only its own process ever killed) and polls /healthz with a bounded 20x500ms retry. The client-facing iframe address is resolved separately via vscode.env.asExternalUri so Remote-SSH needs no manual port forwarding. All 16 static smoke assertions pass, `taskctl verify` and `collision-guard` both pass. One real, structural blocker was found and is NOT hidden: tools/aiworkhub/src/aiworkhub/dashboard.py::DashboardRequestHandler._send_bytes unconditionally sends X-Frame-Options: DENY and CSP frame-ancestors 'none' on every response (static + /api/*), which a browser enforces regardless of the embedding webview's own CSP -- so the iframe will show a browser-level refusal until a separate follow-up task (outside this task's allowed_writes) relaxes those headers for the VS Code webview origin. Everything else in the contract (config, commands, panel reuse, autostart bounds/ownership, CSP restriction, no secrets/LAN IP/Simple Browser) is implemented and verified.

covers: no hardcoded LAN IP / 0.0.0.0 / coordinator token / secret literal
no openExternal / Simple Browser / external browser tab usage
single createWebviewPanel call + guarded reuse + retainContextWhenHidden (panel is created/revealed, never duplicated)
bounded autostart loop (AUTOSTART_MAX_ATTEMPTS) + single-owner process tracking (dashboardProcOwned)
CSP frame-src restricted to the resolved origin, never a wildcard
top-level webview never sets enableScripts: true
install_remote.sh replaces older versions, never mutates settings.json or starts a background service, prints the exact Reload Window / open-command handoff, copies every required asset
all 6 required output files present on disk

data_path_proof.chain: Task MCP /api/snapshot, /api/task, /api/archive, /api/restore (dashboard.py, unmodified) -> served HTML/JS/CSS from dashboard_static/ (unmodified) -> vscode.env.asExternalUri resolves the client-reachable tunnel/loopback address -> sandboxed iframe (sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms") inside the extension's WebviewPanel renders that resolved URL

remote_ssh_behavior.health_check_runs_on: remote/workspace extension host, against the raw loopback dashboardUrl (never the client-resolved address)
remote_ssh_behavior.client_facing_address: vscode.env.asExternalUri(dashboardUrl) -- resolves VS Code's own tunnel; no owner-managed port forwarding required
remote_ssh_behavior.autostart_process: spawned on the remote/workspace host via workspace .venv (tools/aiworkhub/.venv/bin/python3 preferred, falls back to .venv/bin/python3 then bare python3) with PYTHONPATH=tools/aiworkhub/src, loopback host, configured port
remote_ssh_behavior.duplicate_prevention: module-level dashboardProc handle checked before every spawn attempt
remote_ssh_behavior.process_ownership_on_stop: only a process this extension itself started (dashboardProcOwned) is ever killed, on Restart Task Dashboard or deactivate

security_boundaries.top_level_webview_enableCommandUris: restricted to this extension's own 3 command IDs
security_boundaries.dashboard_same_origin_archive_restore_fl: untouched -- entirely inside the framed document, extension never intercepts or forwards it

blocker.description: Every dashboard HTTP response (static assets and /api/*) unconditionally sends X-Frame-Options: DENY and Content-Security-Policy: ...; frame-ancestors 'none'. Browsers enforce frame-ancestors at the framed document, independent of the parent webview's own CSP, so the dashboard currently refuses to render inside this (or any) iframe.
blocker.why_not_fixed_here: dashboard.py is outside this task's allowed_writes (tools/vscode-geoai-task-operations/** and this eval JSON only); modifying it is explicitly out of scope for a worker-scoped write boundary.
blocker.unblocks_when: a separate, explicitly-scoped follow-up task relaxes dashboard.py's anti-framing headers for the VS Code webview origin (e.g. an allowlisted frame-ancestors value derived from the resolved asExternalUri origin, or a dedicated embed-mode flag), then a live reload/install verifies the iframe actually renders end-to-end.
blocker.current_behavior_without_fix: The Activity Bar launcher's Online/Offline status still reflects a real /healthz check and is accurate; the full editor panel's iframe will show a browser-level connection refusal in place of the dashboard until the header is relaxed.

manual_handoff.after_install: Run 'Developer: Reload Window' (or restart the extension host)
manual_handoff.open: Run command: AIWorkHub Tasks: Open Operations Dashboard (or click the AIWorkHub Tasks Activity Bar icon)
